## MC Hoster 1.0.0

Host a Minecraft server from your own PC in four clicks, with **Gh0st AC** already installed. By DarkerDawnFR.

**Download `MC-Hoster.exe` below** and double-click it. You don't need to install anything first: if your PC doesn't have the right Java, MC Hoster finds or downloads it for you.

### What's in it
- **Server tab**: Paper (1.20.6 → 26.3), Purpur, Pufferfish, Spigot and Fabric 1.21.1
- **Minecraft tab**: finds your `.minecraft` folder by itself and adds the server to your Multiplayer list
- **Settings tab**: name, 64×64 PNG icon, max players with a lag meter, game mode, difficulty + hardcore, Gh0st AC (on by default), then **Finish**
- **Play tab**: shows the IP (friends / same Wi-Fi / this PC) with Copy buttons, tries to open port 25565 on your router (UPnP), and has a live console, a command box and Stop/Start buttons
- **My servers…** to start a server again later (or use `start.bat` in its folder)

### Notes
- The exe isn't signed, so Windows may say "Windows protected your PC". Click **More info → Run anyway**.
- The first time the server starts, Windows may ask about Java and the firewall. Click **Allow**.
- Spigot has to be compiled on your PC the first time (5-10 minutes).

Tested on Windows with a real server of every type (Paper latest / 1.21.1 / 1.20.6, Fabric 1.21.1, Purpur, Pufferfish, Spigot), each with Gh0st AC loaded.
